text: The library is open from 8:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday. It is closed on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.
Students can borrow up to 5 books for 14 days. Each extension adds 7 days, with a maximum of 2 extensions, so a book can be kept for a maximum of 28 days in total.
Late books cost 0.50 euro per day.
Tuition can be paid online with a bank card or at the administration office in cash.
Students can pay in 3 installments: September, December and March.
To request a certificate (also called a cert or attestation), email the administration office. It is ready in 3 working days.
Registration opens on September 1st and closes on September 30th. Late registration is possible until October 10th with a 50 euro late fee.
Students must bring their ID card and the previous year's results to register.
